snippet.title: The Ship: Murder Party | PC GAMEPLAY | HD 1440P
snippet.description:
Buy games at a great discount!
https://www.g2a.com/r/discountme


//- Info
For PC gamers who enjoy multiplayer games with a bit of intelligence, intrigue and ingenuity, The Ship is a murder mystery alternative to traditional FPS multiplayer games. Each player is given a Quarry to kill - and must evade their own Hunter in the process, all set on board a series of 1920s art deco cruise ships. 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/2400/


//- Addition
The game that everyone has but never plays. The Ship: HD remake is coming 2016 so I gave the old one a look. Also it was in the steam summer sale so the online is active again!


//- System Recommendation
2.8 GHz Processor
1024MB RAM,
DirectX 9 capable Graphics Card (1024x768)
Windows 2000/XP/ME/98
DirectX 9.0c


//- My System
OS: Windows 8.1 Pro 64bit
MB: Asus Sabertooth Z77
CPU: Intel Core i7-3770K @ 4.2GHz
GPU: Zotac GTX 980 4GB
RAM: Corsair 8GB 1600MHz
PSU: Cougar 550W
